source_excerpt: We grow it under the bench where its bears slender, sinuous flower stalks that produce minute, self-fertile seed that germinates around the parents.
Peperomia asperula Hutchison & Rauh is one of the more commonly grown succulent species, and, like many peperomias, bears slender green spikes with minute, self-fertile flowers.
